notes.title: Update Coming soon...
notes.content:
hi players, as we all know, tczvr is kinda falling flat. we have been focused on the next project, The Slothgate Experiment. Although this is our main focus, we are going to do many fixes, and add in few new features. thank you all for the reviews, we are working to make this game at least decent. this was our first project, so we wanted to do tczvr as more of a first run type of game. with all of this said, we will see you soon...


thanks for playing
~Derrick Does VR

notes.title: patch 1.15 notes
notes.content:
- closed off the stairs in vent run temporarily to fix the falling through map issue.
- increased the border in the exit of vent run so you can no longer glitch into the exit.
- Fixed the Terry’s pizzeria exit so no more glithing there either.

Thanks for playing!
~Derrick Does VR, main dev for this game

notes.title: Patch 1.1
notes.content:
patch notes:
- Removed skipping in the vent run stairs.
- Fixed the Vent Run Creature's jumpscare zone.
- Slowed the player and AI's speed down so the player wont fall out of the map as often.
- Added a developers credits list in the main menu.

thanks for playing the creature zone vr...

~Derrick Does VR, main dev for the creature zone vr.
